extra.message: Hardcoded SECRET_KEY in settings — Attacker can forge session cookies, sign arbitrary data, and decrypt derived secrets, leading to full application compromise. [verified: The SECRET_KEY is hardcoded as a static string in settings.py line 90; no rotation or protection is implemented. The threat model explicitly lists this as a sensitive data exposure, and an attacker leveraging other vulnerabilities (e.g., path traversal) can retrieve it to forge session cookies and sign arbitrary data, leading to full application compromise.]

DEBUG mode enabled in production — Attacker can obtain sensitive internal information (source code, database details, environment variables) through detailed error pages, facilitating further attacks. [verified: DEBUG=True is hardcoded in badguys/settings.py line 10 and the threat model explicitly lists DEBUG=True as a security misconfiguration. No compensating control overrides this setting, and detailed error pages are reachable by any unauthenticated user triggering a runtime error.]
